# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest released version of ccxpLite and the current `main` branch.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report suspected security or privacy vulnerabilities through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/sago-cream/ccxp-lite/security/advisories/new). Do not open a public issue.

Include the affected extension version and browser, reproduction steps, potential impact, and a minimal proof of concept when practical. Remove passwords, session IDs, student records, and other personal information; use fabricated or redacted data instead.

Please avoid accessing accounts or data you do not own, disrupting CCXP services, or publicly disclosing the vulnerability before a fix can be coordinated.

The maintainer will acknowledge the report as soon as practical, investigate it, and coordinate remediation and disclosure with the reporter.
